verdicts.reason: A: the attribution sits at the bottom-left, below and to the left of the quote it belongs to, jammed against the bottom edge, so the reading order is jumbled. The quote text is tiny and hangs in the upper middle with dead space under it, and the SOLSTICE logo is gone. B: the left-to-right flow (quote mark, quote, attribution, product) suits a banner, but the quote is squeezed into three cramped lines of tiny type. The bold attribution is bigger than the quote itself, which inverts the hierarchy, and the logo is also dropped. B is marginally more coherent.
